**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 15 (p0104–p0105) is, despite its heading, a mutual provision: both the direct-damages exclusive remedy and the exclusion of special/indirect/consequential damages run to "either party," and the limitation is expressly disapplied for breaches of Section 13 (IP) and Section 14 (confidentiality). There is no monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement, so Garman's direct-damages liability is uncapped — better for us than the preferred greater-of-12-months'-fees/USD 1,000,000 cap, and none of the walk-away triggers (one-way cap, sub-6-month vendor cap, indemnities inside the cap) are present. Our own exposure is uncapped too, but proposing a cap here would mainly benefit the Vendor, so we leave it. Noted but not flagged: gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud are not named as carve-outs, and payment obligations are not expressly excluded from "damages."
